notes: S4.1 incorrectly states that debounced toggles when the internal cnt reaches STABLE_CYCLES. In the actual transition rule, the threshold sample is accepted when the pre-edge cnt equals STABLE_CYCLES-1; debounced then updates and cnt resets to zero. Thus the internal counter need not and normally does not reach STABLE_CYCLES. The final RTL correctly implements the required consecutive-sample threshold and passes trusted simulation and bounded formal verification.
